sourceDescription: AnixQ — аниме с AnimeLib: каталог, плеер без рекламы, синхронизация с Shikimori.

appRepositories.appDescription:
Search by screenshot: reliable AnimeLib matching and clearer results

trace.moe recognised frames fine; titles were lost when matching to
AnimeLib because many entries lack an AniList id. Matching now tries the
AniList id, then the MAL id (equal to the Shikimori id AnimeLib stores),
then an exact title match. Results are grouped per anime with the AniList
cover, the best match shown as a card with the frame, episode and moment,
a warning for low-confidence matches, and steps logged to Diagnostics.
